name: Intune Log Collector
description: Intune Log Collector is an Azure-based solution that collects logs from Intune-managed devices, including files, directories, and event logs. It deploys a Function App, Storage Account, and Key Vault, with the Remediation script driving log collection per LogsGatherRules.json and uploading a compressed archive to the logs container. Deployments support Azure Template Spec (Bicep/ARM) or direct ARM templates, with optional UI and post-deployment steps.
keywords: how to gather logs from managed devices
author: Nickolaj Andersen

securityCheck.aiSummary: The Intune Log Collector components rely on Azure-managed identities and storage access to fetch and expose data via HTTP. Security concerns center on data exposure through blob content retrieval and SAS token issuance. While authentication and authorization flows appear legitimate, returning blob contents and SAS tokens to callers can enable unintended data access if access controls, token lifetimes, or logging are not tightly restricted. Improve data minimization, redact sensitive identifiers in logs, and consider limiting blob/SAS access to strictly required scopes and durations. No malicious patterns (RCE, credential theft via code, or hardcoded secrets) are evident beyond standard secret management considerations.
